title: Inside OpenAI’s in-house data agent
summary: How OpenAI built an in-house AI data agent that uses GPT-5, Codex, and memory to reason over massive datasets and deliver reliable insights in minutes.
body: How OpenAI built an in-house AI data agent that uses GPT-5, Codex, and memory to reason over massive datasets and deliver reliable insights in minutes.
summaryZh: 本文深入探讨了OpenAI内部数据Agent的构建方式，该Agent融合了GPT-5、Codex以及记忆机制，能够对海量数据集进行深入推理，并在数分钟内交付可靠的业务洞察。这一实践为企业级数据分析Agent的设计提供了重要的架构参考与落地范本。
